profile.summary: Anthony Ryan is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in jQuery's DOM manipulation and HTML parsing. Their contributions focus on fixing parsing regressions and ensuring compatibility with malformed markup, particularly in XHTML environments. While their work is deeply rooted in legacy JavaScript (pre-ES6) and jQuery internals, their ability to identify and resolve parsing issues demonstrates strong debugging skills and attention to code quality. The developer's experience is primarily limited to jQuery's core library, with no evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks or backend systems.
